name: Identity-Only Reference Transfer
purpose: Test identity-lock wording while holding the same project-owned identity fixture and a completely new wardrobe, pose, and environment.
first_party_baseline_prompt: Using a project-owned identity reference, create a new realistic waist-up portrait of the same adult person in a sunlit botanical reading room. Use the reference only for recognizable facial identity; do not import its original clothing, pose, camera angle, or background. Dress the subject in a charcoal knit jacket over a cream shirt, seated beside a leafy window and turning slightly toward the camera with relaxed hands resting on a closed book. Use soft daylight, natural skin texture, and restrained depth of field.
locked_dimensions: charcoal knit jacket and cream shirt

allowed_experimental_mutation_points.description: Compare repeated redundant identity locks with one precise identity-only lock.

reference_fixture_policy: Requires a first-party or project-owned identity fixture; private corpus images must never be used as the experimental reference fixture.

provenance.notes: The prompt is newly authored for AIPF. Private source material informed mechanism selection only; source wording, prompt IDs, images, and creator-specific composition are not embedded.
